data.long_meaning: The meaning of Di is recorded in name-lists as “God's judge”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Di expresses “God's judge”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Di total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: Di
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Di הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Di was a goddess of justice and a judge of the underworld. In Christianity, the name Di may symbolize being a judge of one's own actions and living a righteous life.

in_greek.name: Δι
in_greek.long_meaning: Δι είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα, και σημαίνει Δί, είναι μια μορφή του ονόματος Δίος, που σημαίνει θεός, και χρησιμοποιείται σε πολλούς χριστιανικούς πολιτισμούς

in_latin.name: Di
in_latin.long_meaning: Di est nomen quod derivatur a verbo latino, et significat sufficere, est forma nominis quod significat deum, et usum est in multis culturis christianis
